Title: Monorepo & CI
User story: As an engineer I want a pnpm/Turborepo monorepo with lint, typecheck, unit and integration tests in CI so that every PR is verified.
Acceptance criteria: CI runs on every PR < 10 min; Testcontainers PG+Redis; failing check blocks merge

Title: Infrastructure as code
User story: As the team we want Terraform for VPC, ECS Fargate, RDS PG16, ElastiCache, S3, SES so that staging and prod are reproducible.
Acceptance criteria: terraform apply creates staging from scratch; secrets in AWS Secrets Manager; no manual console changes

Title: Migrations & RLS harness
User story: As an engineer I want SQL migrations (schema_v2) and a request-scoped tenant context so that RLS isolates orgs.
Acceptance criteria: Migration up/down tested; every request sets app.org_id/app.user_id; cross-tenant test suite green

Title: Request pipeline
User story: As an engineer I want auth, idempotency, rate limiting, RFC 7807 errors and request ids in one pipeline.
Acceptance criteria: Idempotency-Key replay returns same response; 429 with Retry-After; problem+json with stable codes

Title: Outbox & jobs
User story: As an engineer I want a transactional outbox relayed into pg-boss queues so that side effects never dual-write.
Acceptance criteria: Event written in same tx; consumer idempotent via processed_events; retries with backoff

Title: Observability
User story: As on-call I want OTel traces, structured logs, Sentry and dashboards so that I can debug production.
Acceptance criteria: Trace spans API→worker→adapter; PII-free logs; error alerts to Slack

Title: Design system in code
User story: As a frontend dev I want tokens (light/dark), Geist fonts and base components matching the design canvas.
Acceptance criteria: Tokens match canvas; button/chip/avatar/card/input/dialog/tabs; dark toggle works

Title: Login with WorkOS AuthKit
User story: As a user I want to sign in with Google, Microsoft or magic link so that I can start quickly.
Acceptance criteria: Login, callback, logout; session cookie HttpOnly/SameSite; CSRF on mutations

Title: Enterprise SSO
User story: As an org admin I want to configure SAML/OIDC SSO via the WorkOS admin portal.
Acceptance criteria: Portal link endpoint; require_sso policy blocks non-SSO login for that org

Title: App shell & mode switcher
User story: As a user I want the global header with Private / Arena / Developer(soon) and notifications.
Acceptance criteria: Matches canvas; Developer disabled with Soon; keyboard accessible

Title: Create organization
User story: As a founder/admin I want to create an org with a Startup or Enterprise preset.
Acceptance criteria: Creator = Org Owner; org_policies seeded from preset; slug unique

Title: Onboarding UI
User story: As a new owner I want a 4-step onboarding (account, organization, knowledge, invite).
Acceptance criteria: Matches canvas Onboarding; progress persists; skippable knowledge step

Title: Org policies
User story: As an org/security admin I want to edit policies (SSO, team creation, guests, agent ceiling, model classes).
Acceptance criteria: Security fields restricted to owner/security_admin; audit on change

Title: Org settings UI
User story: As an admin I want a settings page for org profile and policies.
Acceptance criteria: Form validation; shows which role can edit each section

Title: Org units tree
User story: As an org admin I want to create a BU/department/group tree (≤5 levels) with my own level names.
Acceptance criteria: CRUD; move with cycle check; delete only when empty

Title: Unit roles
User story: As an org admin I want to assign Unit Leads and Unit Admins.
Acceptance criteria: Leads can assign admins in their subtree; audit

Title: Org structure UI
User story: As an org admin I want a tree view with people counts and unit roles.
Acceptance criteria: Matches canvas OrgStructure; drag to move (P1)

Title: SCIM group → unit sync
User story: As an org admin I want IdP groups mapped to units and home units.
Acceptance criteria: WorkOS directory webhook updates memberships within 60 s

Title: Invites
User story: As an admin I want to invite people to org, team or project, including guests with expiry.
Acceptance criteria: Email via SES; token single-use; guest_access_until required for guests

Title: Directory
User story: As a member I want to search people (guests see only co-members).
Acceptance criteria: Search by name/email/unit; presence; RLS-safe

Title: Offboarding
User story: As an admin I want to offboard a member so that access is revoked immediately.
Acceptance criteria: Sessions revoked < 60 s; removed from teams/projects; owner-less projects flagged; Private retention job

Title: Guest expiry job
User story: As security I want guests suspended automatically at expiry with 7-day warning.
Acceptance criteria: Daily job; notification to project owners

Title: Teams CRUD
User story: As a member I want to create a team (if policy allows) and manage members and team roles.
Acceptance criteria: Creator = Team Owner; ≥1 owner invariant; unit assignment

Title: Team page UI
User story: As a team member I want a team page listing members and projects.
Acceptance criteria: Create project entry point; team settings for owners/admins

Title: Org dashboard API
User story: As an org/security admin I want metadata dashboards (projects, stages, progress, blockers, gate wait).
Acceptance criteria: Never returns Arena content; security_invoker view; < 500 ms for 500 projects

Title: Unit dashboard
User story: As a Unit Lead I want the same dashboard scoped to my subtree.
Acceptance criteria: Subtree via path prefix; ancestors' leads included

Title: Dashboard UI
User story: As an admin/lead I want KPI tiles, project table with loop pips, stage distribution.
Acceptance criteria: Matches canvas OrgDashboard; filter by unit/team

Title: Capability catalogue & templates API
User story: As a frontend I want /capabilities and /role-templates.
Acceptance criteria: 27 capabilities; 7 templates from role_templates_v2.json

Title: Setup: roles
User story: As a project creator I want to start from a template and edit roles and capabilities.
Acceptance criteria: Owner role always exists; observer optional; custom role keys unique

Title: Setup: members & gates & agent
User story: As a project creator I want to assign members to roles, configure gates and agent autonomy.
Acceptance criteria: Validation: every approval gate staffed; min_distinct_roles feasible; autonomy ≤ org ceiling

Title: Setup: complete
User story: As a project creator I want one click to create everything atomically.
Acceptance criteria: Single tx: roles, members, gates, policies, arena, cycle #1; then provision central-agent session; idempotent

Title: Setup wizard UI
User story: As a project creator I want the 7-step wizard (basics, members, roles, assign, gates, agent & routines, review).
Acceptance criteria: Matches canvas SetupRoles/SetupGates; template switch rebuilds roles; inline validation

Title: Authz library
User story: As an engineer I want packages/authz implementing doc 03 §3.8 with exhaustive tests.
Acceptance criteria: Matrix tests for all planes; agent ∩ human; SoD; cache by membership_version

Title: Members & roles management
User story: As a project owner I want to add/remove members, assign roles, create/edit custom roles after setup.
Acceptance criteria: Cannot delete role that leaves gate unstaffed; cannot remove last owner

Title: Access requests
User story: As a member I want to request access to discoverable projects; approvers decide with roles.
Acceptance criteria: One pending per user/project; notifications; audit

Title: Project access UI
User story: As a project owner I want members/roles, access requests and agent autonomy in project settings.
Acceptance criteria: Matches canvas ProjectAccess

Title: Observer experience
User story: As an observer I want read-only Arena with a clear banner.
Acceptance criteria: Composer replaced by 'You're an observer'; RLS blocks writes

Title: Arena messages API
User story: As a member I want to post, edit, delete, thread and attach files in the single Arena stream.
Acceptance criteria: Capability checks; @user/@role/@central parsing; partitioned messages

Title: Realtime gateway
User story: As a member I want messages, typing, presence and agent streaming in real time.
Acceptance criteria: WS auth with 5-min token; topic authz; resume via seq; fan-out p95 < 300 ms

Title: Arena UI
User story: As a member I want the Arena screen: stream, loop strip, approval cards, right panel.
Acceptance criteria: Matches canvas Arena; agent messages distinct; tag suggestions

Title: Attachments
User story: As a member I want to attach files to messages.
Acceptance criteria: Pre-signed upload; virus scan status; 100 MB limit

Title: Central agent session provisioning
User story: As the system I want one central-agent runtime session per Arena created at setup.
Acceptance criteria: session_key unique; retries; status visible

Title: @central turns
User story: As a member I want to ask @central and see a streamed, cited answer.
Acceptance criteria: Turn ledger; SSE→WS deltas; cancel; failures surfaced

Title: Ambient batching
User story: As the system I want ambient Arena messages forwarded in batches so the agent stays aware cheaply.
Acceptance criteria: Every 20 msgs or 60 s; reply_expected=false

Title: Agent step drawer UI
User story: As a member I want to see what the agent is doing (steps, tools, approvals).
Acceptance criteria: From step/tool events; no raw reasoning

Title: Routines CRUD & scheduler
User story: As a routine manager I want to create routines from templates with cron (≥1 h).
Acceptance criteria: pg-boss cron; routine_runs unique per slot; pause/resume; run now

Title: Routine execution
User story: As a team I want digests, standups, gate nudges and weekly reports posted by the agent.
Acceptance criteria: mode=routine turns; deterministic fallback when runtime down; autonomy respected

Title: Routines UI
User story: As a routine manager I want a routines page with last run status.
Acceptance criteria: Matches canvas Routines

Title: Private sessions API
User story: As a user I want private sessions with my personal agent.
Acceptance criteria: Owner-only RLS; streaming turns; rename/delete; search own sessions

Title: Private UI
User story: As a user I want the Private home and session screens.
Acceptance criteria: Matches canvas Main/PrivateSession; dock on every screen

Title: Bind & pull context
User story: As a user I want to bind a session to one project and bring a read-only context snapshot.
Acceptance criteria: Write-once bind (DB trigger + runtime :bind); scope mismatch error

Title: Push to Arena
User story: As a user I want to push an artifact version to an Arena with preview and optional gate request.
Acceptance criteria: Never copies session; lineage; binds session; notifications

Title: Bridge UI
User story: As a user I want the push dialog and the Arena private dock with context picker.
Acceptance criteria: Matches canvas PushToArena/ArenaPrivateDock

Title: Artifacts & versions
User story: As a user I want versioned artifacts stored content-addressed in S3.
Acceptance criteria: sha256 dedupe; statuses; diff; export needs artifact.export

Title: Artifact viewer UI
User story: As a user I want to view, diff and version artifacts.
Acceptance criteria: Markdown render sanitized; version history

Title: Tasks API
User story: As a member I want tasks with assignee, priority, weight, due date, dependencies and acceptance criteria.
Acceptance criteria: Weighted progress; completion only via verify

Title: Delegation
User story: As a member I want to delegate a task to a person or a whole role.
Acceptance criteria: Delegation notification to all role holders; accept

Title: AI teammate assignment
User story: As a member I want to assign a task to the AI teammate with a human reviewer.
Acceptance criteria: mode=assignment; agent can only reach in_review; reviewer verifies

Title: Tasks UI
User story: As a member I want a task panel/board with delegation and 'Assign to AI teammate'.
Acceptance criteria: Matches canvas Routines/AI teammate artboard

Title: Cycle state machine
User story: As a team I want cycles with stages and transitions per gate policy.
Acceptance criteria: One active cycle; send back with reason; append-only transitions

Title: Gate approvals & SoD
User story: As an approver I want to vote; min approvals, distinct roles and no-self-approval enforced.
Acceptance criteria: Row lock + version prevents double advance; rejection needs reason

Title: Evidence & GitHub
User story: As a team I want approved stage artifacts committed as evidence and PR/CI links attached.
Acceptance criteria: GitHub App; evidence pending/recorded/failed; retries

Title: Loop UI
User story: As a member I want the loop view (cycles, stage cards, gate decision, history, progress.md).
Acceptance criteria: Matches canvas Loop

Title: progress.md & stage summaries
User story: As a team I want progress.md generated from records after each transition.
Acceptance criteria: Deterministic template; agent narrative after P5; no invented numbers

Title: Notification engine
User story: As a user I want notifications for pushes, stage updates, delegations, tags, DMs, approvals, access requests, assignments, routines.
Acceptance criteria: Dedupe; membership-filtered; deep links; prefs

Title: Inbox UI
User story: As a user I want the notification centre with filters and action-needed section.
Acceptance criteria: Matches canvas Notifications

Title: Direct messages
User story: As a member I want 1:1 and small-group DMs.
Acceptance criteria: Guests only with co-members; realtime

Title: Email digest
User story: As a user I want an optional daily email digest.
Acceptance criteria: SES; unsubscribe; prefs

Title: Search
User story: As a user I want permission-aware search across projects, messages, artifacts, tasks, people and my private sessions.
Acceptance criteria: ACL in SQL; Postgres FTS; p95 < 400 ms

Title: Audit log
User story: As security I want an append-only, hash-chained audit log of consequential actions and exports.
Acceptance criteria: All medium/high-risk actions audited; CSV/JSON export

Title: Audit UI
User story: As a security admin I want to browse and export the audit log.
Acceptance criteria: Filters by actor/action/date

Title: Runtime adapter & stub
User story: As the app team we want the RIC v0.2 adapter and a stub runtime (scripted + thin-LLM).
Acceptance criteria: Conformance kit passes against stub; SSE resume; idempotent turns

Title: App Tools MCP server
User story: As the runtime I need 20 scoped App Tools with capability + autonomy checks.
Acceptance criteria: Token scope enforced; SCOPE_MISMATCH; app_tool_calls logged

Title: Isolation canary suite
User story: As security we want canary tests proving no cross-project or private leakage.
Acceptance criteria: Runs nightly + release gate; 100% pass

Title: Tau integration
User story: As the team we want to swap stub → Tau via config and certify it.
Acceptance criteria: Conformance ≥95%; canary 100%; p95 first event < 3 s

Title: Usage & budgets
User story: As a billing admin I want agent usage per project and org budget caps.
Acceptance criteria: From turn.completed usage; 80/100% alerts; hard stop

Title: YC demo slice
User story: As founders we want a thin end-to-end demo on staging: login → project with custom roles → Arena chat with @central → Private push → gate approve.
Acceptance criteria: Recorded 3-minute demo; runs on stub thin-LLM; seeded org
